entities.summary: Sukanto Tanoto (b. 1949-12-25, Medan Belawan) was a military leader or commander of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Medan Belawan and Indonesia. Known in the fields of indonesia, merchants & economists, asia.
